messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>

Subject: Handoff: Fallbrook Analytics onboarding & go-live readiness

Hi team —

Congrats, Fallbrook signed last Friday. Quick handoff notes and asks so CS can pick up the kickoff and runbook:

Deal summary (high level):
- Contract value: $180k ARR (year 1), Dedicated capacity with private VPC option.
- Primary use case: real-time document search + summarized extracts for customer support workflows.
- Go-live target: phased rollouts starting 2027-07-20; full internal pilot by 2027-09-01.

Key stakeholders (external):
- Alexandra Turner, Head of Platform (primary contact)
- Marcus Lee, Engineering Lead (technical)
- procurement@fallbrookanalytics.com (contracting)

Known constraints / asks:
- Data residency: must keep logs in us-east-1 region and audit logs retained for 13 months (SOC2 requirement).
- They requested an HSM-backed KMS setup — procurement will push through an LOA for key-splitting.
- Network: VPC peering + restricted egress; they'll want internal IP allowlist for the staging cluster.

Attachments I pushed to the drive and included here: Fallbrook_SOW_v1.2.pdf (signed, pending DocuSign finalization), Deployment_Risk_Register.xlsx, RBW_Onboarding_Checklist.csv.

Outstanding commercial items:
- Procurement expects a DocuSign link this week. Finance has approved the special pricing; no additional credits.

Immediate asks for CS:
1) Confirm CS owner and primary SE for the kickoff.
2) Schedule a 60-minute technical kickoff with Fallbrook (Alexandra + Marcus + 2 engineers) between 2027-06-22 and 2027-06-24.
3) Review the attached risk register and call out any blockers for the proposed timeline.

I'm assigning follow-ups today: I can introduce the external contacts on the kickoff calendar invite.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — good context. I'm happy to take point as CS lead for Fallbrook and will be primary owner through pilot to full launch. A few clarifying questions before I schedule the kickoff:

1) For the KMS/HSM ask, do we have the customer's LOA and any initial key policy language from their security team, or is that still with procurement?
2) Can you confirm whether they want Dedicated + Private (VPC) from day 1 or start in Hosted with Private planned later? (We need this to size capacity and pick the deployment template.)
3) Are there specific SLAs or latency targets they shared for the support-facing workflows?

Mina — can you review the Deployment_Risk_Register and call out anything that should be triaged as a blocker for the July 20 phased start?

I'll tentatively block time for a kickoff window on 6/23 10:00–11:00 PT and propose on Marissa's intro. If that works, I'll include an agenda: intro, success metrics, network/KMS requirements, onboarding milestones, next 90 days.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Answers inline:

> 1) For the KMS/HSM ask, do we have the customer's LOA and any initial key policy language from their security team, or is that still with procurement?

Procurement confirmed today they'll send the LOA by EOD Friday (CC'd procurement@fallbrookanalytics.com). I've attached the suggested key policy language they usually use for HSM integration in the drive (see the SOW notes).

> 2) Can you confirm whether they want Dedicated + Private (VPC) from day 1 or start in Hosted with Private planned later?

They want Dedicated + VPC from day 1. Their engineering team specifically asked for isolated capacity and the option to scale independently — that's part of why the deal landed where it did.

> 3) Are there specific SLAs or latency targets they shared for the support-facing workflows?

They asked for 95th percentile <= 180ms for 512-token inference during business hours for the support feature. They'll accept gradual improvements but want that in the SLO conversation.

Test account details (staging):
- Staging URL: https://staging-fallbrook.redwood-test.com (credentials: shared via 1Password, team has read-only service account for initial testing).
- API key: FALLBROOK-TEST-xxxx (will rotate at kickoff).

I've uploaded the signed SOW (pending final DocuSign envelope) and the onboarding checklist.

Marissa

Quick SE note — adding here so we capture a technical constraint:

- Model selection: Recommend starting the pilot on the rdm-13b-optimized variant with int8 quantization for cost/latency trade-offs; we should have a fallback to rdm-13b-quantized-v2 if latency is out of range.
- KV cache sizing: Their average context window per query is ~600 tokens; recommend we provision an extra 20% KV memory to avoid cold-cache spikes during peak.
- Network: we'll need to confirm if Fallbrook requires static source IPs for the Dedicated nodes or if they prefer peered subnets with route tables.

Connor (SE) — happy to jump on the kickoff to walk the architecture and validate our proposed quantization profile.
